about.title: About the Project
about.tagline: Redefining the concept of "waste" into shared value.
about.missionText1: Trash2Treasure is a circular economy platform designed to transform how our communities manage surpluses. Our mission is simple but ambitious: eliminate the concept of "trash" by connecting underutilized objects with people who can renovate, reuse, or recycle them.
about.missionText2: Every item reported on this map is an opportunity to reduce our carbon footprint and strengthen neighborhood bonds through generosity and environmental care.

about.developedBy: Conceptualized and developed entirely by {{author}} under the {{company}} label.

legal.title: Legal
legal.ipText: Both the "Trash2Treasure" trademark and the user interfaces (UI), design, appearance and logos are the exclusive property of Ismael Marot. No part of this application may be copied, reproduced, compiled or commercially distributed.
legal.infoWeCollectText: We collect information you provide directly when you register, create a listing, or interact with other users. This includes your name, email address, and location data when you use the application.
legal.useOfInfoText: We use the collected information to operate, maintain, and improve the Trash2Treasure platform, facilitating connections between users for item exchange. Your approximate location is used exclusively to show nearby items.
legal.shareInfoText: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with unaffiliated third parties for their own marketing purposes without your explicit consent.
legal.acceptTermsText: By accessing or using the Trash2Treasure platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or accessing this site.
legal.usePlatformText: Trash2Treasure is a platform to facilitate the donation and exchange of second-hand goods. It is prohibited to post illegal, offensive, dangerous material or material subject to strict regulations (e.g. weapons, smuggled medications).
legal.disclaimerText: Items are collected "as is". Trash2Treasure does not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of listed items. Exchanges are made at the users' own risk.
legal.eulaText: This license agreement governs your use of the Trash2Treasure application. Under this license, you are granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the software solely for its intended purpose.
legal.restrictionsText: You may not reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble the software. You may not sublicense, rent, or lease any part of the application.
legal.ourCommitmentText: At Trash2Treasure, we are committed to carrying out our mission with the highest standards of integrity, honesty, and legal compliance. We expect our community to act with the same respect and ethics in all their interactions and transactions.
legal.circularEconomyText: We strictly prohibit the use of our platform for illicit activities, exchange of hazardous materials, or any action that harms community well-being. We encourage a culture of inclusion, diversity, and total environmental respect.
legal.mapsText: Our maps and geospatial utilities are powered by the incredible OpenStreetMap data (© OpenStreetMap contributors) and geocoded using Nominatim.
legal.frontendText: The frontend framework uses technologies like React, Leaflet, and styled-components, whose respective open-source licenses are recognized and respected.
